title: ageratum conyzoides subsp. latifolium
intro: Ageratum conyzoides subsp. latifolium, commonly known as Mexican bluebell, is a plant species belonging to the Ageratum genus. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory disorders, due to its therapeutic actions such as antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Ageratum conyzoides subsp. latifolium include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Additionally, the plant has been found to exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, further highlighting its potential therapeutic applications.
